overall: Atlanta is tracking a warm, humid morning with temps at 78.8°F and a running max of 80.6°F as of 8:50 AM ET. A slight chance of afternoon thunderstorms after 2 PM (20% PoP) introduces some downside risk to the peak, but current sky coverage and wind pattern are consistent with a typical summer high-heat trajectory.
forecast_obs_notes: There is notable spread between the NWP models — HRRR (92.4°F) and NWS (92°F) are aligned on the upper end, while ECMWF (89.5°F) and NBM (89.6°F) cluster roughly 2-3°F cooler. max_temp_prediction: The active Kalshi market uses odd buckets, and the ensemble strongly favors the 91-92°F bucket at 84.7% (Tier 1, high confidence). The current warming rate of +1.8°F/hr and peak timing forecast around 14-16h ET leaves ample time to reach the low 90s before any convective inhibition from afternoon storms. Balancing HRRR/NWS guidance (92°F) against the cooler ECMWF/NBM signal and the modest afternoon storm risk, the most likely TMAX is right at the 91-92°F range, with HRRR's 92.4°F as a credible upper bound. Confidence is moderately high — the primary downside risk is an earlier-than-forecast thunderstorm development suppressing the peak below 90°F, but the 20% PoP makes this a secondary scenario.
